content.question: Which statement about the mathematical properties of the L1 and L2 penalties is correct?
options: The L1-penalty is not differentiable at zero, while the L2-penalty is smooth and differentiable everywhere.
Both L1 and L2 penalties are non-differentiable at zero, so gradient descent cannot be used with either.
The L1-penalty is smooth and differentiable everywhere, while the L2-penalty has a sharp corner at zero.
Both penalties are differentiable everywhere, but only L1 supports gradient descent.
content.answer: The L1-penalty is not differentiable at zero, while the L2-penalty is smooth and differentiable everywhere.
